questions.n: Clouds hang horizontally; baffles hang vertically.

questions.n: The live room bleeds its reverberation into the other.

questions.q: Carpets and fabrics absorb well only when they are:
o: Thick and heavy, or mounted over an air gap
questions.n: Mass, thickness and backing raise their absorption.

questions.n: Curved surfaces focus sound into hot spots.

questions.n: The slits and cavity form the resonating system.

Keeping it away from mechanical rooms

questions.n: Too late to blend but not quite a distinct echo.

questions.n: It covers sound production, transmission and absorption in buildings.
